//: Example WorldMap configuration. Copy values into appsettings.{Environment}.json, user-secrets, or environment variables. DO NOT commit real onboarding tokens, encryption keys, or connection strings.

Onboarding.//: Operator-preprovisioned onboarding records. Each token binds a civ to a fixed civId/keyId and a secretRef resolved from Secrets:Map. Provision tokens/secrets out-of-band (env/Key Vault); never commit real values.

Secrets.//: Reference -> secret map. In App Service these are settings backed by Key Vault references; locally use user-secrets/env. Never commit real secrets.
